case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 1347-1349 OF 2023; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 1351 OF 2023
summary: Land acquisition under Land Acquisition Act, 1894; challenge to State's refusal to release acquired land; High Court directed release on grounds of Article 14 violation due to inconsistent treatment; State argued completed acquisition, public interest, and infrastructure use (sewage line, road widening, shopping mall); differential treatment of similarly situated landowners; issue of arbitrariness in retention of land; public purpose vs. equal protection.
legal_provisions_cited: Land Acquisition Act, 1894 s.4, s.5A, s.6
final_judgment: Appeal(s) allowed; impugned judgment of High Court set aside; direction to release land quashed; acquisition upheld.
